body.en: If you want to step away from your computer while keeping a close eye on AI progress, you can now take over directly from another device. ⟦Just like enabling cross-device mirroring on a living room console, where pairing with a tablet lets you watch the screen and operate the controller even while walking into the kitchen, with the tunnel immediately closing upon disconnecting or shutting down for safety.⟧ By adding the `--remote-control` flag when launching the tool or typing the `/remote-control` command in a conversation, you can create a dedicated connection to follow and control the terminal in real time from a phone or tablet. Typing `/remote-control off` or closing the session automatically tears down the tunnel and unregisters the device list. This connection also fixes permission inheritance issues, ensuring commands initiated remotely fully inherit the original permission mode, cycle mode, and file access grants. Even when data directory names differ, the companion interface faithfully renders rich artifact cards.

items.original:
Added Remote Control (start a connection via `--remote-control` startup flag or `/remote-control` slash command) to create a session-scoped remote connection for following and controlling your active terminal session from another device. Typing `/remote-control off` or closing the session automatically tears down the tunnel and unregisters the device from the active Remote Control session list.
Fixed turns triggered from a connected Remote Control session or running across secondary workspaces executing without the CLI session's active permission mode, cycle mode, and non-workspace file access grants.
Fixed artifacts in the Remote Control companion rendering as plain `<name>.md` file links instead of rich artifact cards when the CLI's application data directory differs from the default bundle name.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式解除執行時限，背景伺服器常駐且錯誤排查更精準
title.en: Headless Mode Removes Execution Time Limits, Keeps Background Servers Running, and Improves Error Diagnostics

body.zh-TW: 把耗時的繁重任務交給自動化腳本執行時，無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）現在不會因為時間到了就強制中斷。⟦恰如工廠在夜間啟動無人值守的自動化流水線，只要不設關機定時器，機台就會耐心運轉直至所有工件加工完畢；若是途中遇上原料斷供或故障，控制面板立刻印出含錯誤代碼的結構化清單。⟧使用 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行時，預設逾時已從 5 分鐘調整為無限制，讓耗時較長的任務能一路執行到回覆完畢，除非手動加上 `--print-timeout` 參數。在具備 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 的工作階段中，背景伺服器指令也會在回合結束後保持運作。此外，當因 API 失敗中斷時，CLI 在標準錯誤輸出 `AGY_ERROR: {...}` JSON 紀錄，詳列標準狀態、HTTP 或 gRPC 錯誤代碼、是否可重試與錯誤識別碼，並將結束代碼改為 `3`。
body.en: When handing off time-consuming heavy tasks to automation scripts, headless mode no longer forcibly terminates when time runs out. ⟦Just like starting an unattended automated assembly line in a factory at night, where machines run patiently until all workpieces are processed unless a shutdown timer is set, and the control panel immediately prints a structured list with error codes if materials run out or a breakdown occurs midway.⟧ When running with `-p` or `--prompt`, the default timeout has been changed from 5 minutes to unlimited, allowing long-running tasks to execute until the response finishes unless the `--print-timeout` parameter is passed manually. In sessions with `GEMINI_API_KEY`, background server commands also remain running after the turn ends. Additionally, when terminated due to an API failure, the CLI prints an `AGY_ERROR: {...}` JSON record to standard error detailing canonical status, HTTP or gRPC error codes, retryability, and error IDs, while updating the exit code to `3`.

items.original:
Changed the default timeout for headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs from 5 minutes to unlimited so long-running agent turns run until the response completes unless `--print-timeout` is passed explicitly, and enabled daemon background commands in headless `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions so background servers stay running after the turn finishes.
Improved headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) error reporting when a turn terminates on an agent or model API failure: the CLI now prints a structured `AGY_ERROR: {...}` JSON line on stderr with canonical status, HTTP or gRPC error code, retryability, and error ID (including HTTP status mapping for `GEMINI_API_KEY` SDK errors) and exits with code `3` instead of `1`.

title.zh-TW: 編輯器游標支援標點斷詞，路徑與參數修改更俐落
title.en: Editor Cursor Supports Punctuation Boundaries for Snappier Path and Flag Editing

body.zh-TW: 鍵盤游標在提示詞編輯器中穿梭時，單詞跳轉與文字刪除變得更加細膩。以前按下單詞跳轉快捷鍵時，游標只會在空格處停下，如果遇到用斜線或符號連接的長網址，一跳就會衝過頭，刪除時也會把整串路徑一口氣刪光。⟦這就像長途列車原本只能在縣市大站停靠，現在每一處轉運站的交接月台都能精準煞停，讓你能隨心所欲單獨檢視或卸下某個特定車廂。⟧現在系統改進了分詞規則，游標移動快捷鍵（如 `Alt+F`、`Alt+B` 以及方向鍵組合）遇到標點符號時都會主動停下。單詞刪除鍵（如 `Ctrl+W`、`Alt+Backspace` 和 `Alt+D`）同樣會在標點邊界煞停。無論是檔案路徑中的各層目錄、網址或是各項參數設定，你都能精準按節跳轉或逐步刪除。
body.en: Word navigation and text deletion have become much more refined when moving the keyboard cursor through the prompt editor. Previously, when pressing word-navigation shortcuts, the cursor only stopped at whitespace, causing it to overshoot long URLs joined by slashes or symbols and wipe out entire path strings when deleting. ⟦This is like a long-distance train that could only stop at major city stations, but can now halt precisely at transfer platforms at every transit hub, letting you inspect or detach a specific railcar at will.⟧ The system has now improved word boundary rules so cursor movement shortcuts (such as `Alt+F`, `Alt+B`, and arrow key combinations) actively stop at punctuation marks. Word deletion shortcuts (such as `Ctrl+W`, `Alt+Backspace`, and `Alt+D`) likewise stop at punctuation boundaries. Whether dealing with directory levels in file paths, URLs, or various parameter flags, you can now navigate precisely by segment or delete step by step.

items.original: Improved word-wise cursor movement (`Alt+F`, `Alt+B`, and `Ctrl`/`Alt`+Arrow keys) and word deletion (`Ctrl+W`, `Alt+Backspace`, and `Alt+D`) in the prompt editor to stop at punctuation boundaries instead of only whitespace, making it easy to step through or delete individual segments of file paths, URLs, and flags.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕產物檢視器純文字複製，不再誤選行號與留白
title.en: Full-Screen Artifact Viewer Copies Plain Text Without Accidentally Selecting Line Numbers and Padding

body.zh-TW: 滑鼠在全螢幕產物檢視器中拖曳選取時，複製出來的內容不再夾帶多餘雜訊。以前只要滑鼠拖曳過螢幕，系統就會連同最左側的行號邊緣欄以及右側的尾隨間距一併選入，貼上時還得手動刪除行號。現在這個問題已經修好，拖曳只會反白並複製文件本身的文字內容；你還能隨時按下 `Ctrl+C` 重新複製當前選取的範圍、按 `Esc` 清除選取，或是使用 `Shift` 鍵搭配拖曳來保留原生終端機的選取方式。
body.en: When dragging to select with the mouse in the full-screen artifact viewer, copied content no longer includes unwanted noise. Previously, dragging across the screen would capture the leftmost line-number gutter along with trailing padding on the right, requiring you to manually delete line numbers after pasting. This issue has now been fixed: dragging highlights and copies only the document text content itself. You can also press `Ctrl+C` at any time to re-copy the active selection, press `Esc` to clear the selection, or hold `Shift` while dragging to retain native terminal selection.

items.original: Fixed text selection in the full-screen artifact viewer capturing the line-number gutter and trailing padding; dragging across the viewer now highlights and copies only the document text, with `Ctrl+C` to re-copy an active selection, `Esc` to clear it, and `Shift`+drag for native terminal selection.

title.zh-TW: 執行中切換模型改為依序排隊，進行中對話不再中途遭換
title.en: Mid-Run Model Switches Now Queue in Order Without Swapping In-Flight Turns

body.zh-TW: 趁著 AI 正在回答問題時提前輸入下一句指示並指定模型，現在系統會乖乖排隊而不會打亂現狀。以前在回合運作中途輸入 `/model <name> <prompt>` 指令，系統會立刻切換執行中的模型，導致正在產出的內容中途被換掉。這個問題已經修好，單次模型切換現在會耐心等待，直到該筆排隊的提示詞正式開始執行時才會切換，確保當前進行中的回合與更早排隊的提示詞，都能完整使用工作階段（session）原本的模型順利跑完。
body.en: When entering a subsequent instruction with a specified model while the AI is actively answering, the system now queues it properly without disrupting ongoing work. Previously, submitting the `/model <name> <prompt>` command midway through a running turn would immediately switch the active model, causing in-flight generations to be swapped mid-stream. This issue has now been fixed: one-shot model switches now wait patiently until the queued prompt begins executing, ensuring both the currently running turn and any earlier queued prompts finish completely on the session's original model.

items.original: Fixed submitting `/model <name> <prompt>` while a turn is already running switching the active model immediately in the middle of the in-flight turn; the one-shot model switch now waits until the queued prompt begins executing so the running turn and any earlier queued prompts finish on the session's original model.

title.zh-TW: 超大變更不撐爆對話儲存，倒帶復原不再誤覆寫成果
title.en: Oversized Edits No Longer Exceed Session Storage, and Rewind Reverts Avoid Overwriting Work

body.zh-TW: 遇到超大檔案變更或需要倒帶復原進度時，工作階段（session）的儲存與工作區狀態現在更加穩固。⟦宛如厚重帳本在歸檔龐大資料時，只記錄增減行數與摘要而省略整份原始收據，避免抽屜爆滿被整箱清空；翻查紀錄時也會精準比對目標頁數，不再盲目拿過期的舊存根來覆寫現狀。⟧以前當檔案修改的差異內容大於 1 MiB 時，會因超出對話儲存上限而導致整個工作階段被強制清空。現在超大編輯會保留行數變更統計，並自儲存歷程中省略龐大的原始差異內容，在執行 `/rewind` 時也會直接略過省略部分。此外，過去使用 `/rewind` 進行對話復原或建立分支時，若略過了近期的快照，系統可能會倒退掃描至過舊的工作區快照，默默覆寫保留的修改；現在尋找快照會從目標步驟向前搜尋，若無較新快照則採用逐步復原重播作為備援。
body.en: When encountering massive file changes or rewinding progress, session storage and workspace states are now significantly more stable. ⟦Just like a thick ledger archiving voluminous records by logging only line counts and summaries while omitting bulky raw receipts to prevent overflowing drawers from being dumped out entirely, and referencing precise target page numbers during audits rather than blindly overwriting the present with outdated stubs.⟧ Previously, when file modification diffs exceeded 1 MiB, exceeding the conversation storage limit would force-clear the entire session. Oversized edits now preserve line-change statistics while omitting the massive raw diff content from stored history, and `/rewind` directly skips elided diffs during reverts. Additionally, when using `/rewind` for conversation reverts or forks in the past, skipping recent snapshots could cause the system to sweep backward to an outdated workspace snapshot and silently overwrite kept modifications. Snapshot lookup now sweeps forward from the target step, falling back to step-by-step revert replay when no newer snapshot exists.

items.original:
Fixed file edits with diffs larger than 1 MiB exceeding the conversation storage limit and force-clearing the session; oversized edits now preserve their line-change statistics while omitting the raw diff body from stored conversation history and skipping the elided diff during `/rewind` reverts.
Fixed `/rewind` conversation reverts and forks sweeping backward to an older workspace snapshot when recent snapshot commits were skipped, which could silently overwrite kept work; snapshot lookup now sweeps forward from the target step and falls back to step-by-step revert replay when no later snapshot exists.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 自訂代理自動注入子代理指引與名冊
title.en: Automatic Subagent Guidance and Roster Injection for Markdown Custom Agents

body.zh-TW: 在 Markdown 檔案中自訂專案 AI 代理時，現在能讓代理更聰明地分工協作。⟦好比連鎖餐廳為新進店長準備的交接手冊，只要職責包含調度人力，手冊第一頁就會自動附上當班員工名冊與各崗位指派流程，讓店長一接單就能精準把工作分派給專屬外場或廚房助手。⟧當你透過 Markdown 格式定義自訂代理，並在工具清單中列入 `invoke_subagent` 工具時，這項新增機制會自動在該代理的系統提示詞（給予 AI 底層角色的指令設定）中注入目前可用的子代理名冊與詳細使用指引。自訂代理現在能確實依據名單調度所宣告的子代理，不再因為缺乏使用說明而無法分工。
body.en: When customizing project AI agents in Markdown files, agents can now collaborate and divide work more intelligently. ⟦Just like an onboarding handbook prepared by a chain restaurant for a new store manager, where as long as their duties include scheduling staff, the first page automatically includes the on-duty staff roster and station assignment workflows, allowing the manager to accurately dispatch work to dedicated front-of-house staff or kitchen assistants upon receiving orders.⟧ When you define custom agents in Markdown format and include the `invoke_subagent` tool in their tool list, this new mechanism automatically injects the currently available subagent roster and detailed usage guidance into that agent's system prompt. Custom agents can now reliably delegate to their declared subagents based on the roster, rather than failing to divide work due to missing instructions.

items.original: Added automatic subagent guidance for custom agents defined in Markdown: agents that list `invoke_subagent` in their tools now receive the roster of available subagents and usage instructions in their system prompt, so they can actually delegate to the subagents they declared.

title.zh-TW: 背景任務保留原始命名，通知與清單不再顯示通用代號
title.en: Background Tasks Retain Original Names in Notifications and Lists Instead of Displaying Generic Identifiers

body.zh-TW: 將耗時較長的繁重指令丟到背景執行時，隨時掌握各項進度變得更加直覺。以前當你把工作指派至背景執行時，系統往往會將任務名稱替換成自動產生的通用代號，讓人難以一眼辨認哪項工作已經跑完。現在系統改進了背景任務命名機制，任務被移至背景時會完整保留當初給定的專屬名稱。不論是終端機跳出的完成通知，或是隨時查詢的背景任務清單，現在都會清楚呈現原本的任務名稱，方便你精準對照各項作業。⟦恰如乾洗衣物送交櫃台送洗時，防塵套上始終保留你親筆寫下的送洗衣物標籤，取件通知與待洗清單上都清楚列出那是哪一套衣物，不再只標註一串冰冷隨機的收件流水號。⟧
body.en: Keeping track of progress is now much more intuitive when sending long-running, heavy commands to run in the background. Previously, when assigning work to run in the background, the system often replaced the task name with an auto-generated generic identifier, making it hard to tell at a glance which job had finished running. The background task naming mechanism has now been improved so that tasks fully retain their originally given custom names when moved to the background. Whether in completion notifications popping up in the terminal or in queryable background task lists, the original task name is now clearly displayed, allowing you to accurately cross-reference each operation. ⟦Just like dropping off dry cleaning at the counter, where the garment bag always keeps the handwritten laundry tag you wrote, and both the pickup notification and pending laundry list clearly specify which outfit it is, rather than only labeling an impersonal, random receipt serial number.⟧

items.original: Improved background task naming so a task keeps the name it was given when sent to the background; completion notifications and task lists now show that name instead of a generic auto-derived one.

title.zh-TW: 憑證遭拒時自動登出清除，暫時性網路故障保住工作階段
title.en: Automatic Sign-Out and Cleanup on Rejected Credentials While Preserving Sessions During Transient Network Failures

body.zh-TW: 帳號權限變更或遇上網路波動時，登入狀態的管理現在更加精準可靠。⟦宛如飯店櫃台的房卡管理，當櫃台確認房客已正式退房結清時，讀卡機會主動清除房卡晶片裡的舊鑰匙以便重新配卡；但若是感應線路短暫繁忙或讀卡機反應延遲，系統絕不會隨意註銷仍在住宿期間的房客權限。⟧以前當企業帳號被撤銷或失效等情況發生，登入伺服器明確拒絕身分時，過期的登入憑證仍可能殘留在本機。現在命令列工具會自動將你登出並清除過期 token（授權令牌），讓你能乾淨重新登入。與此同時，若是遇上暫時性的網路連線失敗、伺服器錯誤或請求速率限制，系統也絕不會誤刪你的工作階段（session），確保作業不被中斷。
body.en: Managing sign-in status during account permission changes or network fluctuations is now significantly more accurate and reliable. ⟦Much like room key card management at a hotel front desk, where the card reader proactively clears old keys from the card chip for re-issuance once the front desk confirms a guest has officially checked out and settled their bill, but the system never arbitrarily cancels the access of an actively staying guest if the sensor line is briefly busy or the card reader responds slowly.⟧ Previously, when situations like enterprise account revocations or invalidations occurred and the sign-in server definitively rejected the identity, stale sign-in credentials could still linger locally. The CLI tool now automatically signs you out and clears stale tokens so you can sign in again cleanly. Meanwhile, if transient network connection failures, server errors, or request rate limits occur, the system will never accidentally drop your session, ensuring operations remain uninterrupted.

items.original: Fixed stale credentials lingering after the sign-in server definitively rejects them (for example a revoked or invalidated enterprise account); the CLI now signs you out and clears the stale tokens so you can sign in again cleanly, while temporary network failures, server errors, and rate limits never cost you your session.

title.zh-TW: 指令遭外部中斷正確標記取消，遠端工作階段同步顯示中斷提示
title.en: Commands Terminated by External Signals Correctly Marked as Canceled with Remote Sessions Syncing Interruption Hints

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行指令或多端連線操作時，取消與中斷狀態的紀錄現在更加準確。以前當執行中的指令受到外部信號終止（例如整個工作階段在指令運作中途關閉），系統會錯誤將其記錄為結束代碼 0 的成功執行。現在這類指令會正確標記為已取消，並完整保留中斷前所收集到的輸出紀錄。此外，過去只有在本機終端機按下 Esc 鍵時才會跳出 `Interrupted` 中斷提示，現在只要當前回合確實被取消，包括從已連線的遠端工作階段停止操作，畫面上都會如實顯示中斷提示。⟦這好比高鐵列車在行駛途中若因外部緊急訊號中途停靠，行車電腦會將該趟行程準確標註為中途取消並保留先前的行駛紀錄，駕駛座與遠端調度螢幕也都會同步亮起醒目的中斷提示燈號。⟧
body.en: Recording cancellation and interruption states is now more accurate when running commands in the terminal or operating across connected sessions. Previously, when a running command was terminated by an external signal (such as when the entire session shut down mid-run), the system erroneously recorded it as a successful execution with exit code 0. Such commands are now properly marked as canceled while fully preserving the output logs collected before the interruption. In addition, whereas the `Interrupted` hint previously only appeared when pressing the Esc key locally in the terminal, it now faithfully displays on screen whenever the current turn is actually canceled, including when stopped from a connected remote session. ⟦This is like a high-speed train stopping mid-route due to an external emergency signal: the on-board computer accurately marks that trip as canceled mid-way and preserves prior driving logs, while prominent interruption warning lights illuminate synchronously across both the driver's console and the remote dispatch screen.⟧

items.original:
Fixed commands killed by an outside signal (for example when the whole session shuts down mid-run) being recorded as successful runs with exit code 0; such commands now finish as canceled while keeping the output collected before the interruption.
Fixed the `Interrupted` hint only appearing when Esc was pressed locally in the terminal; it now appears whenever the current turn is actually cancelled, including when it is stopped from a connected remote session.

title.zh-TW: 終端機視窗縮放自動重新折行，對話思考進度框不再卡死凍結
title.en: Terminal Resizing Automatically Re-wraps Text and Resolves Frozen In-Progress Thinking Frames

body.zh-TW: 隨意縮放終端機視窗或重載對話時，畫面排版與狀態呈現變得更加順暢。以前在調整終端機視窗大小後，成品檢視器（展示生成檔案與程式碼的預覽介面）中的 Markdown 文字會卡在原始寬度無法自動換行。此外，對話歷史中進行中的思考進度框有時也會永久凍結，例如畫面永遠停留在 `Thinking... (31s)` 的狀態，即使縮放視窗或重新載入工作階段也無法恢復。現在這兩項介面顯示問題都已修好，文字內容會自動配合新的視窗尺寸重新折行排版，思考框也能如常更新進度。⟦彷彿電子書閱讀器在切換螢幕寬度時，文章內頁會即時配合新版面重新排版折行，正在載入的進度轉圈圖示也不會因為畫面縮放而卡死在螢幕上。⟧
body.en: Layout and status presentation are now much smoother when freely resizing the terminal window or reloading conversations. Previously, after resizing the terminal window, Markdown text in the artifact viewer remained stuck at its original width without re-wrapping automatically. Furthermore, in-progress thinking frames in conversation history would sometimes freeze permanently—such as staying stuck forever at `Thinking... (31s)`—without recovering even after resizing the window or reloading the session. Both interface display issues are now resolved: text content automatically re-wraps to fit the new window dimensions, and thinking frames update progress normally. ⟦Just as when switching screen widths on an e-reader, where article pages instantly reflow and re-wrap to match the new layout, and loading progress spinners do not freeze on screen due to screen resizing.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the artifact viewer leaving markdown text stuck at its original width after a terminal resize; content now re-wraps to the new window size.
Fixed in-progress thinking frames occasionally freezing permanently in the conversation history (for example showing `Thinking... (31s)` forever), including after a terminal resize or session reload.

title.zh-TW: 新增 /skills reload 指令，免重啟工作階段即時重載技能
title.en: Added /skills reload Command to Instantly Reload Skills Without Restarting Session

body.zh-TW: 在終端機對話中途擴充技能或自訂指令，現在完全不必打斷當前思路。⟦宛如舞台劇在演出進行中，後台助理在側幕無聲換上新道具與曲目劇本，前台演員不必中斷表演，觀眾的觀賞體驗也絲毫不受干擾。⟧當你正在跟 AI 協同開發，臨時新增了一項技能檔案或自訂斜線指令，想立刻在對話中使用卻不想結束當前對話，這正是鍵入 `/skills reload` 的時刻。這項新增的子指令會在背景非同步重新載入所有偵測到的技能與斜線指令，既不用重新啟動工作階段（session），也不會暫停或鎖定你的終端機鍵盤輸入，讓你一邊繼續提問、一邊立即取用最新擴充。
body.en: Expanding skills or custom commands mid-conversation in the terminal no longer requires interrupting your flow. ⟦Just like backstage assistants quietly swapping in new props and scripts from the wings during an ongoing stage play, without the actors ever pausing their performance or the audience experiencing any disruption.⟧ When collaborating with AI and adding a new skill file or custom slash command that you want to use right away without ending the ongoing session, this is the exact moment to type `/skills reload`. This newly added subcommand asynchronously reloads all discovered skills and slash commands in the background without restarting the session or blocking terminal keyboard input, allowing you to keep asking questions while immediately utilizing the latest extensions.

items.original: Added a `/skills reload` subcommand to asynchronously reload discovered skills and slash commands without restarting the session or blocking user input.

title.zh-TW: 新增 /model 行內自動補齊與互動選單模糊搜尋列
title.en: Added Inline Autocomplete for /model and Fuzzy Search Bar in Interactive Picker

body.zh-TW: 切換對話所使用的運算模型時，現在不必再死記複雜的型號代碼。⟦好比走進大型圖書館的數位檢索機，只要在鍵盤敲入幾個關鍵字，螢幕即刻跳出推薦書單，挑選時更能依書名或索書號即時模糊比對，迅速定位想借閱的館藏。⟧當你需要針對複雜任務切換運算模型，這正是輸入 `/model` 的時刻。現在只要在終端機輸入 `/model` 時，輸入列就會即時彈出行內參數的自動補齊下拉選單；若進入互動式選單介面，上方還新增了即時模糊搜尋列，讓你能直接輸入模型名稱或型號 ID 快速過濾篩選，挑出最合適的目標。
body.en: When switching compute models during a conversation, you no longer need to memorize complex model IDs. ⟦Like searching a digital catalog in a large library, typing a few keywords on the keyboard immediately brings up recommended books, with real-time fuzzy matching across titles and call numbers to quickly locate desired items.⟧ When you need to switch compute models for complex tasks, this is the moment to enter `/model`. Typing `/model` in the terminal now instantly pops up an inline argument autocomplete dropdown; entering the interactive menu interface provides a live fuzzy search bar at the top, enabling you to filter quickly by model name or ID and pick the most suitable option.

items.original: Added an inline argument autocomplete dropdown when typing `/model` and a live fuzzy search bar inside the interactive `/model` picker to filter models by name or ID.

title.zh-TW: OAuth 權限不足時明確提示執行 /logout 與 /login 指令
title.en: Explicit Instructions to Run /logout and /login When OAuth Permissions Are Insufficient

body.zh-TW: 登入驗證遇到權限不足時，錯誤提示現在會給出明確的修復指引。以前當你的 OAuth token（授權令牌）缺少系統所需的存取權限範圍時，終端機只會拋出晦澀的授權失敗訊息，讓人不知該如何處理。現在系統改進了身分驗證錯誤提示，會直接在畫面中列出清晰的修復步驟，主動指引你依序執行 `/logout` 登出與 `/login` 重新登入指令以更新權限。⟦這如同門禁通行證上的感應權限不足時，驗證閘門不再只閃爍冰冷的紅燈，而是清楚指示你前往服務櫃台辦理註銷並重新感應登錄。⟧
body.en: Error messages now provide explicit remediation instructions when encountering insufficient permissions during authentication. Previously, when an OAuth token lacked required access scopes, the terminal merely threw an obscure authorization failure message, leaving users unsure how to resolve it. Authentication error prompts have now been improved to display clear recovery steps directly on screen, actively guiding you to run `/logout` and `/login` sequentially to refresh permissions. ⟦Like an access gate that no longer just flashes a cold red light when a security badge lacks permissions, but clearly instructs you to visit the service desk to revoke and re-authenticate.⟧

items.original: Improved authentication error messages when OAuth tokens lack required scopes by including explicit instructions to run `/logout` and `/login`.

title.zh-TW: 修復切換至 Gemini 思考模型與聯網搜尋摘要的解析異常
title.en: Fixed Parsing Errors When Switching to Gemini Thinking Models and Web Search Summaries

body.zh-TW: 無論中途切換至具備推理能力的 Gemini 思考模型，或是執行聯網搜尋，運作流程現在更加順暢。以前若前幾輪對話是由非 Gemini 模型所產生，中途切換為 Gemini 思考模型時，系統會因為找不到前序對話的 `thought_signature`（思考簽章）而跳出格式驗證錯誤。此外，使用 `search_web` 聯網搜尋工具時，若負責產出摘要的模型在開頭吐出了思考過程片段，也會導致搜尋以 `"no summary returned from GenerateContent"` 錯誤失敗。這兩項思考模型解析問題現在都已經修好，模型切換與搜尋摘要皆能如常運作。⟦有如不同樂團的指揮家在中途接力交接樂譜，就算前段演奏並未標註特定的呼吸記號，接棒的指揮也能順暢接續演奏，不再因為記譜格式不同而中斷整場音樂會。⟧
body.en: Workflows now run much smoother whether switching mid-conversation to Gemini thinking models equipped with reasoning capabilities or executing web searches. Previously, when prior conversation turns were generated by non-Gemini models, switching mid-session to a Gemini thinking model would fail with format validation errors due to missing `thought_signature` from previous turns. In addition, when using the `search_web` tool, if the summarization model emitted leading thought parts, the search would fail with a `"no summary returned from GenerateContent"` error. Both parsing issues with thinking models have now been fixed, allowing model switching and search summaries to function as expected. ⟦Like guest conductors handing off sheet music mid-performance, the incoming conductor continues smoothly even if earlier passages lacked specific breathing marks, preventing the concert from halting over notation differences.⟧

items.original:
Fixed mid-conversation model switching to Gemini thinking models failing with `thought_signature` validation errors when prior turns were generated by non-Gemini models.
Fixed web search (`search_web`) failing with `"no summary returned from GenerateContent"` when the summarization model emits leading thought parts.

title.zh-TW: 工具呼叫格式錯誤時代理迴圈會回傳錯誤並自我修正
title.en: Agent Loop Returns Errors and Self-Corrects on Tool Call Validation Failures

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 自動調用工具時，若參數格式不合規，流程不再直接斷線罷工。以前當工具呼叫未通過結構驗證（schema validation）時，對話輪次會過早以 `NO_TOOL_CALL` 錯誤直接終止，導致工作被迫中斷。現在這個問題已經修好，代理迴圈會將驗證錯誤訊息回傳給 AI，讓模型能即時理解錯誤並自動修正參數重新呼叫。
body.en: When letting AI invoke tools automatically, invalid argument formats no longer abruptly terminate the workflow. Previously, when a tool call failed schema validation, the conversation turn would terminate prematurely with a `NO_TOOL_CALL` error, forcing work to halt. This issue has now been resolved: the agent loop returns the validation error message to the AI, allowing the model to promptly understand the error, correct its arguments, and retry the call.

items.original: Fixed agent turns terminating prematurely with `NO_TOOL_CALL` when a tool call fails schema validation, allowing the agent loop to return the validation error and self-correct.

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 工具定義原地修改與 hooks.json 遭預算截斷問題
title.en: Fixed In-Place MCP Tool Definition Mutation and hooks.json Token Budget Truncation

body.zh-TW: 自訂擴充設定與外部工具整合，現在運作更加穩定可靠。⟦彷彿工廠流水線在擴充新模具時，直接複製了一份專屬加工樣板，既不會在共用設計圖上塗改破壞原有尺寸標準，也不會在控制台進行總長度修剪時遺漏了預先掛載的感應開關。⟧以前系統在為 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充工具結構時，會直接在記憶體中就地修改工具定義，導致後續觸發嚴格參數驗證失敗。同時，當自訂內容啟動 token（AI 處理文字的計量單位）預算截斷機制時，原本在 `hooks.json` 設定的掛鉤規則還會無預警被整份丟棄。這兩項設定遺失與參數驗證問題現在都已修好。
body.en: Custom extension configurations and external tool integrations now operate with greater stability and reliability. ⟦Like a factory assembly line duplicating a dedicated processing template when expanding with new molds, neither defacing original dimension standards on shared blueprints nor dropping pre-mounted sensor switches during total length trimming on the console.⟧ Previously, when the system augmented tool schemas for MCP (Model Context Protocol), it mutated tool definitions in place in memory, triggering subsequent strict argument validation failures. Meanwhile, when customization token budget truncation was activated, hook rules configured in `hooks.json` were silently dropped without warning. Both configuration loss and parameter validation issues have now been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed MCP tool schema augmentation mutating tool definitions in place, preventing strict argument validation failures.
Fixed `hooks.json` configurations being silently dropped when customization token budget truncation is active.

title.zh-TW: 修復自訂子代理 exclude 技能過濾遺失與終止狀態被誤重設問題
title.en: Fixed Custom Subagent exclude Skill Filter Loss and Accidental Reset of Termination Status

body.zh-TW: 指派專門分工的自訂子代理（subagent，負責特定分工的輔助 AI）協同工作時，權限過濾與狀態追蹤更加精確。以前當系統在執行階段套用技能過濾時，自訂子代理會遺失原本設定的 `exclude` 技能排除清單。同時，在發布訂閱機制的批次合併更新下，已被終止的子代理也容易因晚到的步驟更新而被錯誤重設為活躍狀態。這兩項技能過濾與狀態追蹤問題現在都已經修好。⟦恰如專案主管指派外包團隊執行特定任務，既確保外包團隊不會擅自碰觸被禁止的機密工具，也在任務結案並撤銷權限後，不會因晚到的進度回報而誤將該小組重新標示為作業中。⟧
body.en: Permission filtering and status tracking are now more precise when delegating tasks to specialized custom subagents. Previously, when runtime skill filtering was applied, custom subagents would lose their configured `exclude` skill filter lists. Additionally, under pubsub batch coalescing updates, killed subagents could be mistakenly reset to active status by late step updates. Both skill filtering and status tracking issues have now been fixed. ⟦Like a project manager assigning specific tasks to an outsourced team, ensuring they cannot touch restricted confidential tools, and preventing the team from being mistakenly marked active by delayed progress reports after the task is closed and permissions are revoked.⟧

items.original:
Fixed custom subagents losing configured `exclude` skill filters when runtime skill filtering is applied.
Fixed subagent status and termination tracking under pubsub batch coalescing so killed subagents are not reset to active by late step updates.

title.zh-TW: 修復重啟後對話與背景常駐工作無法自動復原及日誌遺漏問題
title.en: Fixed Conversation and Daemon Background Task Auto-Resume Failures and Omitted Logs After Restart

body.zh-TW: 終端機重新啟動後的對話復原與除錯記錄，現在更加完整可靠。以前當對話中仍有正在進行的發言輪次、或是背景有正在執行的 daemon（背景常駐程式）工作時，重新啟動後往往無法順利自動恢復對話。同時，終端機中發生的 `ERROR` 錯誤步驟（例如工具執行失敗或逾時），過去也常在 `transcript.jsonl` 對話記錄檔中被意外漏掉。這兩項工作階段自動復原與日誌記錄問題現在都已經修好。⟦宛若航行記錄器在飛行中忠實記錄每一筆警報日誌，即使儀表系統在中途重新開機，所有正在運作的背景巡航裝置也能在重啟後立即接續運轉。⟧
body.en: Conversation recovery and debug logging following terminal restarts are now more complete and dependable. Previously, when a conversation had active turns or daemon background tasks running, auto-resuming the session smoothly after a restart often failed. Furthermore, terminal `ERROR` steps (such as failed tool executions or timeouts) were frequently omitted from `transcript.jsonl` conversation logs. Both session auto-recovery and logging issues have now been resolved. ⟦Like a flight recorder faithfully logging every alarm during flight, all operational background cruising systems can immediately resume running after a reboot, even if instrument systems restart mid-air.⟧

items.original:
Fixed conversations with active turns or running daemon background tasks failing to auto-resume after a restart.
Fixed terminal `ERROR` steps (such as failed tool executions or timeouts) being omitted from `transcript.jsonl` conversation logs.

title.zh-TW: SSH 連線於 Apple_Terminal 停用不支援的超連結跳脫序列
title.en: Disabled Unsupported Hyperlink Escape Sequences in Apple_Terminal Over SSH Connections

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 遠端連線在 macOS 原生終端機操作時，畫面文字不再出現多餘的亂碼符號。以前使用 `Apple_Terminal` 建立 SSH 連線時，由於終端機不支援特定的超連結格式，畫面上會直接印出未解析的 OSC 8 原始跳脫序列（escape sequences）。現在系統已主動停用不支援的超連結序列，這個顯示問題已經修好，遠端文字呈現恢復乾淨整潔。
body.en: Terminal text no longer displays stray garbled characters when operating over SSH connections in native macOS terminals. Previously, when establishing SSH connections using `Apple_Terminal`, unsupported hyperlink formats caused raw, unparsed OSC 8 escape sequences to print directly to the screen. The system now proactively disables unsupported hyperlink sequences, resolving this display glitch and restoring clean remote text rendering.

items.original: Fixed raw OSC 8 escape sequences rendering in `Apple_Terminal` over SSH connections by disabling unsupported hyperlink sequences.

title.zh-TW: 週額度用完警示校準推算邏輯，短暫衝刺不再引發誤報
title.en: Weekly quota exhaustion warnings calibrate projection logic, preventing false alarms from brief usage bursts

body.zh-TW: 密集使用 AI 時，週額度用完警示不再因短時間衝刺就誤報。⟦這好比行車電腦預估剩餘續航，不能只因剛踩了幾秒重油門，就驚呼整桶油在半小時內見底。⟧過去只拿最近 30～60 分鐘的消耗速度外推整個 7 天週期，密集工作階段常引發假警報（例如本週用了 53.7%、還有 3 天 1 小時重置，卻警告「13 小時後用完」）。現在 `assess_weekly_quota()` 同時檢查兩種速度：短窗速度若預測 1 小時內用完仍會立刻示警；其餘情況須整週平均速度預測用完時間提前至少 20%（`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`）才警示。介面改為顯示整週平均預測的時間，不再出現「8h55m 後用完」卻與旁邊 5 小時工作階段額度矛盾的狀況；5 小時工作階段額度警示規則維持不變。
body.en: During intensive AI use, weekly quota exhaustion warnings no longer trigger false alarms from short bursts of activity. ⟦This is like a trip computer estimating remaining range—it shouldn't panic that the entire tank will run dry in half an hour just because you stepped on the gas for a few seconds.⟧ Previously, it extrapolated only the burn rate from the last 30–60 minutes across the entire 7-day cycle, so intensive sessions often triggered false alarms (such as using 53.7% this week with 3 days and 1 hour until reset, yet warning "runs out in 13 hours"). Now, `assess_weekly_quota()` checks both rates: if the short-window rate predicts exhaustion within 1 hour, it still warns immediately; otherwise, the whole-week average rate must predict exhaustion at least 20% early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before raising a warning. The interface now displays the time predicted by the whole-week average, eliminating confusing scenarios where "runs out in 8h55m" contradicted the adjacent 5-hour session quota; rules for 5-hour session quota warnings remain unchanged.

items.original: **The weekly quota warning no longer fires from a short burst of use, and the time it shows now matches the reason it fired** ([#138](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/138)). It used to extrapolate only the last 30–60 minutes of burn rate onto the 7-day window, so a dense working session alone could trigger a false alarm (e.g. 53.7% used, 3 days 1 hour to reset, warned "runs out in 13 hours"). `assess_weekly_quota()` now checks both rates: the short window still warns immediately if it alone predicts exhaustion within an hour, but otherwise the whole-week average must predict exhaustion at least 20% of the reset window early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before it warns — and displays that average's time instead of the short window's, which previously could show a number like "runs out in 8h55m" next to a warning actually driven by a slower week-long trend, contradicting the separate 5-hour session quota shown beside it. Session-quota warnings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣支援 UTF-8 BOM 設定檔，徹底告別卡死與載入中
title.en: Windows system tray supports UTF-8 BOM config files, resolving freezes and endless loading

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦上，當 Claude 設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json` 帶有 UTF-8 BOM（位元組順序記號，部分編輯器在開頭加入的隱藏標記），系統匣面板不再卡在 `--` 與 Loading。過去 `installer/setup_hook.py` 用一般 `utf-8` 開啟檔案，Python 的解析器把開頭帶 BOM 的有效檔案判為 `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` 錯誤，導致啟動自我修復步驟在刷新迴圈跑完前就失敗。現在 `_load_settings()` 與舊版遷移邏輯皆改用 `utf-8-sig`，不論檔案有無 BOM 都能正常讀取且設定內容不變。⟦這宛如收發窗口先前看到信件開頭多了一枚印章，就誤判整份合規公文無效而拒絕拆閱；換上相容的判讀方式後，運作才重回正軌。⟧
body.en: On Windows, when Claude's config file `~/.claude/settings.json` contains a UTF-8 BOM (byte order mark, a hidden marker added at the beginning by some editors), the system tray panel no longer gets stuck at `--` and Loading. Previously, `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, causing Python's parser to reject valid files with a BOM with an `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` error, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop could complete. Now, both `_load_settings()` and the legacy migration logic use `utf-8-sig`, reading the file properly whether a BOM is present or not without altering parsed settings. ⟦This is like a mailroom rejecting a valid official document simply because it has an extra stamp at the top; switching to a compatible reading method puts operations back on track.⟧

items.original: **The Windows tray panel could stay stuck at `--` and Loading forever when `~/.claude/settings.json` had a UTF-8 BOM.** `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, and Python's JSON decoder rejects an otherwise-valid file that starts with a BOM with `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM`, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop ever completed. Both readers (`_load_settings()` and the legacy-usage migration) now open the file as `utf-8-sig`, which accepts the file with or without a BOM and does not change the parsed settings.

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表內建互動日期切換，外寄檔案免裝 app 隨開即查
title.en: HTML reports now feature interactive date filtering, letting recipients explore data instantly without installing an app

body.zh-TW: 將匯出的 HTML 報表寄給同事或主管時，對方現在打開網頁就能自由挑選想看的日期範圍。⟦這好比寄給客戶一張附帶迷你算盤的互動報價單，對方輕撥頂端滑軌，整張單據的各項統計數字便立刻重算。⟧過去報表在產生的那一刻就把區間寫死，收到檔案的人完全無法切換視角；若要改看上週數據，只能請你重跑一次指令。新版直接將約 80 KB 的「日 × 工具 × 模型 × 專案」彙總表嵌入網頁中，所有牽涉日期的區塊都在瀏覽器內即時計算。頁面上方設有吸頂日期列，提供五個快捷範圍與自訂起訖日；不需安裝 app 也不必重新產檔，分享出去的檔案依然能完整操作。至於那些固定觀察特定天數的區塊，介面也會清楚標明涵蓋範圍，避免切換日期時讓人誤以為畫面故障。
body.en: When emailing an exported HTML report to teammates or managers, recipients can now freely select the date range they want to inspect right on the page. ⟦It is like sending a client an interactive quote with a mini abacus attached: they nudge a slider at the top, and all totals across the document instantly recalculate.⟧ Previously, the report locked its timeframe at generation time, leaving recipients unable to adjust the view; switching to last week's numbers meant asking you to rerun the command. The new version directly embeds an ~80 KB summary table of "day × tool × model × project" into the page, and every date-dependent section recalculates live in the browser. A sticky date bar at the top provides five shortcut ranges and a custom from/to range. No app or regeneration is required, keeping shared files fully functional. Sections covering a fixed number of days clearly indicate their span, preventing users from assuming the view is broken when switching dates.

items.original: **The report's date range can be changed inside the page** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). The HTML report used to freeze its period at generation time, so a copy sent to someone else could not be explored. A day × tool × model × project table (about 80 KB) is now embedded, and every date-dependent section recalculates in the browser from five shortcuts or a custom from/to range in a sticky bar. No app and no regeneration are needed, so a shared file stays fully usable. Sections that always cover a fixed span say so, so they don't look broken when the dates change.

title.zh-TW: 清理對話紀錄不再遺失用量歷史，快照持久化小計與花費
title.en: Cleaning up transcripts no longer erases usage history, with snapshots persisting totals and costs

body.zh-TW: 刪除舊的對話紀錄釋放硬碟空間，歷史報表不再跟著消失。過往報表每次都從 `~/.claude/projects` 與 `~/.codex/sessions` 重算，這些紀錄每月約增長 1.9 GB，清掉舊檔等於抹平歷史。新版將小計以工作階段、日期、工具、模型與專案五個維度存入 `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` 快照檔，並記錄各工作階段（session）的開始時間與時長，排行榜也能救回。若某天讀取的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）少於快照，當天改由快照還原；已存花費原樣沿用，不依今日價格重新計價。實測今天、本週、最近 7 天、本月與全部五個範圍，模擬紀錄全刪與完整留存產出的報表，除產生時間外逐字相同。⟦這宛如會計部將厚重簽單彙總成分類帳，日後銷毀過期單據，收支與排行依然分毫不差。⟧
body.en: Deleting old conversation transcripts to free up disk space no longer wipes out historical reports. Previously, reports recomputed everything from `~/.claude/projects` and `~/.codex/sessions`, which grow by roughly 1.9 GB each month, so clearing old files meant erasing history. The new version saves subtotal snapshots across five dimensions—session, date, tool, model, and project—into `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json`, while also recording each session's start time and duration so rankings survive. If a given day's loaded tokens are fewer than in the snapshot, that day is restored from the snapshot. Saved costs are kept as-is rather than repriced against today's prices. In tests across five ranges—today, this week, last 7 days, this month, and all—reports generated with transcripts fully kept versus simulated as completely deleted were byte-identical, except for generation time. ⟦This is like an accounting department summarizing heavy receipts into a ledger: even if expired receipts are later shredded, revenue, expenses, and rankings remain exact.⟧

items.original: **Report history survives transcript cleanup.** The report recomputed everything from `~/.claude/projects` and `~/.codex/sessions`, which grow by roughly 1.9 GB a month, so deleting old transcripts erased report history with them. Totals are now kept in `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` at (session, date, tool, model, project) grain, plus each session's start time and duration so the session ranking survives too. When a day's live transcripts hold fewer tokens than the snapshot, that day is replayed from the snapshot; stored costs are used as-is rather than repriced against today's price list. On real data, reports for today / week / last 7 days / month / all were byte-identical except for the generation time with transcripts present and with all of them simulated as deleted.

title.zh-TW: 報表依閱讀動線重新排版，視覺降噪並最佳化手機瀏覽
title.en: Report layout reorganized around reading flow, reducing visual noise and optimizing mobile viewing

body.zh-TW: 用量報表打開後，版面按閱讀順序重排。⟦像把年報改成目錄，先放總覽，撤掉重複圖表，細節收進可展開頁籤，手機也不迷路。⟧順序是摘要卡、用量趨勢、工具、專案、高花費工作階段、固定週期群組、計算方式、年度回顧。主力模型區塊因重複工具數字而移除；工具列可展開模型，切換日期後保持展開；專案甜甜圈圖因重複排行而刪除。每週燃燒趨勢改名為「用量趨勢」。token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）組成、快取命中率與花費可信度收進折疊的計算卡，五個 fixed range 標籤變成群組上方說明。色條改成底緣 2px 細線，只有 token 數字維持黃色；摘要卡獨立成圓角框，先顯示縮寫數字，下方列精確數字。區塊間距、標題大小與左右邊界也統一，可展開列滑過會高亮。手機上專案一行、工具兩行，工作階段表格橫滑，熱圖保留可讀格子並自動捲到最新週數。開頭摘要移除專案數，因非 git 資料夾與重播歷史會墊高數字。
body.en: When opening the usage report, the layout is now rearranged in reading order. ⟦It is like turning an annual report into a table of contents: leading with the overview, stripping redundant charts, tucking details into expandable tabs, and keeping mobile navigation effortless.⟧ The sequence is now summary cards, usage trend, tools, projects, costliest sessions, fixed-span group, calculation details, and Year in Review. The main model section was removed because it duplicated tool numbers; tool rows can expand to reveal models and remain open after switching dates; the project donut chart was removed for repeating ranking data. "Weekly burn trend" is renamed to "Usage trend". Token composition, cache hit rate, and cost confidence are tucked into a collapsed calculation card, while five "fixed range" tags became a single note above their group. Colored bars were replaced with 2px lines along the bottom edge, with only token figures keeping their yellow color. Summary cards are separate rounded boxes that display abbreviated numbers first, followed by exact figures underneath. Section spacing, heading sizes, and horizontal margins are unified, with expandable rows highlighting on hover. On mobile, projects take one line and tools take two lines, session tables scroll horizontally, and the heatmap retains readable grid cells while automatically scrolling to the latest weeks. The opening summary removes the project count, as non-git folders and replayed history inflate the figure.

items.original:
**The report is reorganised around what people read first.** Order is now summary cards → usage trend → your tools → projects → costliest sessions → the fixed-span group (heatmap, habits, recent work, insights) → how these numbers are calculated → Year in Review. The main-model section repeated the tools section's numbers exactly, so it is gone; each tool row now expands to show its models, and expanded rows stay open when the date range changes. The project donut repeated the ranking below it and was removed. "Weekly burn trend" is now "Usage trend". Token mix, cache hit rate and cost confidence live in a collapsed "How these numbers are calculated" card. The five "fixed range" tags became one note above the group they apply to.
**Visual pass across the report.** Filled bars behind ranking, tool, composition and weekly rows became 2px tracks along the bottom edge; only token figures stay yellow. Summary cards are separate rounded boxes that lead with the abbreviated number and show the exact count underneath. Section spacing and title sizes are consistent, every section shares one left and right edge, and expandable rows highlight on hover. On phones, a project is one line instead of four, a tool is two lines instead of four, the session table scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, and the heatmap keeps readable cells and opens scrolled to the latest weeks.
**The summary sentence no longer states a project count.** Projects are attributed by working folder, so non-git folders and replayed history still inflate the number enough to mislead.

title.zh-TW: 新增每日用量堆疊圖與花費可信度，工具分色不再混淆
title.en: New daily stacked usage chart and cost confidence, with distinct tool colors eliminating confusion

body.zh-TW: 想看清各家 AI 每天的花費與用量節奏，報表新增了直觀的每日用量圖表。圖表每天顯示一根堆疊長條並依工具分色，右上角提供 Tokens 與花費切換開關，滑鼠懸停即可檢視當日用量細項，切換日期時也會跟著重新繪製。為了讓各家工具一目了然，Grok 的代表色改為粉紅色，徹底解決過往綠色與相鄰 Claude 綠色混在一起難以分辨的困擾。此外，報表增設「花費可信度」標記，明確列出有多少比例的用量具備公開價格、多少沒有，並直接點名缺乏公開報價的模型。介面也明白告知讀者，統計顯示的金額是依公開價目表折算的 API 等值花費，並非你的訂閱制月租帳單。⟦這種透明度恰如商務飯店出具的明細單，每天的消費以不同顏色長條清楚區分，附上幣別切換與項目透視，並誠實註記未定價項目的等值折算依據。⟧
body.en: To provide clear visibility into daily spending and usage pacing across different AIs, the report adds an intuitive daily usage chart. The chart displays a stacked bar per day colored by tool, featuring a Tokens/Cost toggle in the top-right corner and hover tooltips for daily breakdowns, automatically redrawing when the date range changes. To make each tool instantly recognizable, Grok's color is changed to pink, resolving the issue where its previous green blended into the adjacent Claude green. In addition, the report introduces a "Cost confidence" badge that specifies the exact proportion of usage backed by public pricing versus unpriced usage, explicitly naming models without public rates. The interface also clearly informs readers that reported costs represent API-equivalent values calculated from public price lists rather than subscription bills. ⟦This transparency is like an itemized hotel invoice where each day's expenses are distinguished by colored bars, complete with currency toggles, line-item breakdowns, and clear explanations for estimated unpriced services.⟧

items.original:
**Daily usage chart.** A stacked bar per day, coloured by tool, with a Tokens/Cost toggle, a hover breakdown, and redraws when the date range changes.
**Cost confidence.** Shows how much usage has a public price and how much does not, names the unpriced models, and states plainly that cost is the API-equivalent value from public price lists, not a subscription bill.
**Grok is pink in the report.** Its previous green sat next to Claude's green in the stacked daily chart and the two could not be told apart.

title.zh-TW: Claude 子目錄工作階段依 Git 歸屬專案，快取擴大防止重複查詢
title.en: Claude sessions in subdirectories attributed to parent repo via Git, with expanded cache preventing repeated lookups

body.zh-TW: 在專案子資料夾啟動 Claude，用量現在會正確歸入同一個母專案。過去 `adapters/claude.py` 處理工作階段（session）只取路徑最後一層名稱，導致 `tests/`、`docs/` 或 `panels/` 都被誤算成獨立專案。新版改用與 Codex、Grok 及 Antigravity 相同的 `resolve_project_name()` 判斷 git 根目錄。為了避免多個工具的資料夾加總後反覆呼叫 `git`，共用快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）上限從 256 筆調升至 2048 筆。只能從小計快照還原的舊日期，則沿用當時記下的資料夾名稱。⟦這彷彿收發室先前只看包裹的辦公室門牌，把同一部門信件拆給不同客戶；改查大樓總地址後，信件才正確歸入同案。⟧
body.en: Launching Claude inside a project subfolder now correctly attributes usage to the same parent project. Previously, `adapters/claude.py` handled sessions by taking only the last folder name in the path, causing `tests/`, `docs/`, or `panels/` to be miscounted as standalone projects. The new version switches to `resolve_project_name()`, matching Codex, Grok, and Antigravity to determine the git root. To avoid repeated `git` calls when aggregating folders across multiple tools, the shared cache limit was raised from 256 to 2048 entries. Older dates that can only be replayed from subtotal snapshots retain the folder names recorded at that time. ⟦It is as if a mailroom previously looked only at office door numbers on packages, sorting letters for the same department into different client bins; checking the building's main address finally routes every mail item to the correct project.⟧

items.original: **Claude sessions opened in a repo subfolder no longer count as separate projects.** `adapters/claude.py` used only the last folder name, so `tests/`, `docs/` and `panels/` each became a project. It now uses the same `resolve_project_name()` git lookup as Codex, Grok and Antigravity, and the shared cache grew from 256 to 2048 entries so several tools' folders together don't push it into repeated `git` calls. Days that can only be replayed from the snapshot keep the folder names recorded at the time.

title.zh-TW: 報表修復排版與圖表比例，校準前期統計與混合計價
title.en: Report fixes layout and chart proportions, calibrating prior-period comparisons and mixed pricing

body.zh-TW: 瀏覽 HTML 報表時，多項版面與統計問題已修正。前期比較不再算到資料起始日之前，排除了如 `↑2799%` 的假成長；工具分組混到未定價模型也不再把整組花費隱藏成 `—`，Antigravity 曾被藏起的 $166 現已正常顯示。因 `.rank-line` 的 `display:grid` 權重高於瀏覽器 `[hidden]` 導致收合失效的問題已排除，收合列會確實收起；`.tokens-cell` 補上 `position:relative`，工作階段（session）排行的長條不再全疊在頁面左上角；展開的模型子列修正尺規，不再把專案佔比套用總量尺度，避免佔專案 68.7% 的模型看起來比專案本身大三倍。⟦這好比校對帳冊排版，校正前後期基準日，把摺疊欄位確實藏起並歸位重疊圖條，不再讓細項畫得比總額還長。⟧
body.en: Several layout and statistical issues in the HTML report have been resolved. Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data, eliminating artificial growth spikes such as `↑2799%`. Tool groups mixed with unpriced models no longer hide their entire cost as `—`, properly displaying Antigravity's previously hidden $166. An issue where `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` overrode the browser's `[hidden]` attribute has been fixed, ensuring collapsed rows actually collapse. Adding `position:relative` to `.tokens-cell` prevents session ranking bars from piling up in the top-left corner. Expanded model sub-rows now use corrected scaling rather than plotting project share on the total-volume scale, preventing a model accounting for 68.7% of a project from looking three times larger than the project itself. ⟦This is like proofing a ledger's layout: calibrating baseline comparison dates, properly hiding collapsed rows, repositioning overlapping bars, and preventing sub-items from being drawn longer than the total.⟧

items.original:
**Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)), which produced growth like `↑2799%`.
**A tool group with one unpriced model no longer hides its whole cost** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); Antigravity's $166 had been shown as `—`.
**Collapsed rows actually collapse** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` outranked the browser's `[hidden]`, so collapsing changed the DOM but not the screen.
**Session ranking bars no longer pile up in the top-left corner** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); `.tokens-cell` was missing `position:relative`.
**Expanded model rows are no longer wider than their parent.** Child bars were drawn as share-of-project on the same scale as the parent's share-of-total, so a model at 68.7% of a project looked three times bigger than the project itself.

title.zh-TW: Windows 啟動時不再連閃黑色主控台視窗，子行程全面安靜呼叫
title.en: Windows startup no longer flashes black console windows, child processes fully silenced

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 啟動 Usage 時，桌面不再連閃黑色主控台視窗。⟦這好比助手出門採買，每趟都按門鈴吵到客人；改走安靜通道後，前台才重回安寧。⟧usage.exe 打包時無主控台，但呼叫子行程未帶 CREATE_NO_WINDOW，使系統每次都開關黑窗。閃爍次數等於歷史目錄數，因 resolve_project_name() 跑 git worktree list --porcelain。現由 usage_common/subprocess_utils.py 統一為子行程帶旗標與標準輸入 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL。複製至 ~/.claude/ 的腳本改採內聯實作且經 ast 測試零相依，轉發器補上 FORWARDER_VERSION 與 self_heal()，比照其他 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）自動換新。
body.en: When launching Usage on Windows, the desktop no longer repeatedly flashes black console windows. ⟦This is like an assistant going out for errands and ringing the doorbell every trip, disturbing guests; switching to a quiet hallway restores peace to the front desk.⟧ usage.exe is packaged without a console, but calling child processes did not pass CREATE_NO_WINDOW, causing the system to open and close a black window every time. The flash count equaled the number of history directories because resolve_project_name() runs git worktree list --porcelain. usage_common/subprocess_utils.py now uniformly supplies flags for child processes along with standard input stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL. Scripts copied to ~/.claude/ now use inlined implementations verified by ast tests to have zero dependencies, and the forwarder adds FORWARDER_VERSION and self_heal() to auto-update just like other hooks.

items.original: **No more black console windows flashing at Windows startup** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). `usage.exe` is packaged without a console, but no `subprocess` call in the project passed `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`, so Windows created and closed a console window for every child process. The flash count equalled the number of distinct project directories in the Claude history — `resolve_project_name()` runs `git worktree list --porcelain` once per directory and caches per process, so every launch repeated it. A shared `usage_common/subprocess_utils.py` now supplies the `creationflags`, every child process in the project goes through it, and the missing `stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL` was added along the way. `usage_session_resume.py` and `usage_statusline_forwarder.py` are copied verbatim into `~/.claude/` and run by the system Python, so they keep an inlined equivalent instead of importing the project; a new test uses `ast` to keep every copied-out script free of project imports. The forwarder also had no version-upgrade path at all — `_copy_forwarder_script()` was only called on reinstall or when the state looked broken — so it gained `FORWARDER_VERSION` and a `self_heal()` upgrade step like the other hooks.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板不再先閃現舊位置，單次設定尺寸坐標徹底消除跳動
title.en: Windows panel no longer flashes at old position, single geometry update eliminates jumpiness

body.zh-TW: 點開 Windows 面板時，畫面不再先在舊坐標閃爍一下才跳回定位。pywebview 的 WinForms 後端在 resize() 與 move() 都帶 SWP_SHOWWINDOW，使 _place_window_on_ui_thread() 提早在舊坐標顯示視窗，隨後才移到定點。以 1 毫秒取樣實測，面板在錯位可見 36 毫秒，約兩個畫面幀。現在視窗改在隱藏時以單次 SetWindowPos 一起設定位置與大小且不帶顯示旗標，顯示交由 show() 處理；非 Windows 或取不到原生視窗時退回既有備援流程。套用前也會先比對目前的實體像素幾何，完全相同便跳過，避免 _apply_content_height_now() 在高度未變時白白呼叫。⟦這種穿幫宛如舞台劇換幕，道具桌還留在上一場的站位，工作人員就失手拉開布幕才急忙把它推定位。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows panel, the screen no longer flashes briefly at its old coordinates before snapping into position. The WinForms backend of pywebview passed SWP_SHOWWINDOW in both resize() and move(), causing _place_window_on_ui_thread() to prematurely display the window at previous coordinates before moving it to its target location. Measured at 1 ms sampling, the panel was visible in the wrong position for 36 ms, or about two frames. The window now sets position and size together via a single SetWindowPos without show flags while hidden, leaving display to show(), and falls back to the existing fallback flow off Windows or when native handles are unavailable. It also compares the current physical-pixel geometry before applying and skips entirely if identical, preventing _apply_content_height_now() from being called unnecessarily when height is unchanged. ⟦This glitch is like a stage scene change where the prop table is still at the previous scene's spot when staff accidentally pull open the curtain before hastily shoving it into place.⟧

items.original: **The Windows panel no longer flashes at its old position before moving.** pywebview's WinForms backend passes `SWP_SHOWWINDOW` in both `resize()` and `move()`, so the `resize()` in `_place_window_on_ui_thread()` made the still-hidden window visible at the previous coordinates; the following `move()` then moved it and only then did `show()` run. Measured at 1 ms sampling, the window sat visible in the wrong place for 36 ms, about two frames. Position and size are now applied while the window is hidden in a single `SetWindowPos` without `SWP_SHOWWINDOW`, leaving display to the existing `show()` path; without a native handle, or off Windows, it falls back to `resize()` + `move()` unchanged. Applying geometry is also skipped entirely when the current physical-pixel geometry already matches, so `_apply_content_height_now()` no longer makes a pointless native call when the content height has not changed.

title.zh-TW: Linux 套件庫全面換用新金鑰，舊安裝需更新金鑰圈
title.en: Linux Package Repositories Switch to New Signing Key, Existing Installs Require Keyring Update

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新或安裝 `gh` 若遇到驗證錯誤，可能是本機尚未登記新印鑑。⟦這好比社區大樓換了新門禁印章，住戶若沒登記新印記，警衛核對舊印鑑就會拒絕放行。⟧ GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與管理軟體的官方倉庫）與個別 RPM 包。它們現在僅以新的 PGP 金鑰（fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`）簽署。若你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前透過官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫安裝 `gh` 且尚未更新金鑰圈（存放信任憑證的鑰匙庫），安裝或升級可能失敗。請依照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換指引更新金鑰圈以排除問題。Windows 與 macOS 使用者，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器及原始碼安裝者，則不受影響。
body.en: If you encounter verification errors when updating or installing `gh` on Linux, your system may not have registered the new stamp yet. ⟦This is like a residential community switching to a new access control stamp; if residents haven't registered the new mark, security checking the old stamp will deny entry.⟧ GitHub CLI's APT and RPM package repositories and individual RPM packages are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`). If you installed `gh` through the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not yet updated your keyring, package installation or upgrades may fail. Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to update your keyring and resolve the issue. Users on Windows and macOS, or those who installed via Homebrew, GitHub Releases, other package managers, or from source, are not affected.

items.original:
## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: 登入驗證碼預設自動複製，省下繁瑣手動步驟
title.en: Authentication Codes Copied to Clipboard by Default, Saving Manual Steps

body.zh-TW:
登入 GitHub 帳號或刷新授權時，終端機現在會自動幫你保管驗證碼，省下一道手動複製手續。過去執行 `gh auth login` 登入或 `gh auth refresh` 刷新權限時，畫面會給出一組要在瀏覽器填寫的 OAuth 裝置代碼（在授權網頁輸入以確認本機身分的驗證碼）。以往得手動反白並複製，現在執行這兩項指令時，預設會主動將代碼複製進剪貼簿，切換視窗直接貼上即可。⟦這好比到櫃檯辦業務時，人員直接把號碼牌遞到你手裡，不必自己拿筆在旁邊抄號碼。⟧ 若想永久關閉此功能，可執行設定指令：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

單次呼叫時若有明確指定剪貼簿選項，依然享有最高優先權。
body.en:
When signing in to your GitHub account or refreshing authorization, the terminal now automatically handles the verification code for you, saving a manual copy step. Previously, running `gh auth login` to sign in or `gh auth refresh` to refresh permissions displayed an OAuth device code to be entered in the browser. While you previously had to manually highlight and copy it, running these two commands now copies the code to the clipboard by default, allowing you to switch windows and paste directly. ⟦This is like visiting a service counter where the staff hands the queue slip directly to you, so you don't have to write the number down yourself with a pen.⟧ To permanently disable this feature, run the configuration command:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options specified for an individual invocation still take highest precedence.

items.original:
## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:
## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

title.zh-TW: 在命令列直接把截圖和影片附進 issue 與 PR
title.en: Attach screenshots and videos to issues and PRs from the command line

body.zh-TW:
⟦你把沖洗好的照片一張張貼進日誌本，寫到哪一頁就貼在哪一頁；頁面上原本寫著「照片放這裡」的位置，照片會直接蓋上去，其他頁則往後補貼。⟧回報問題時想附一張截圖，以前得先開網頁上傳。現在 `gh` 多了 `--attach`，直接把本機的圖片和影片傳上去，接進 issue、pull request 或留言的內文。

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

內文若已經寫到那個本機路徑，`gh` 會把它換成上傳後的網址；沒寫到就補在最後。同一次指令要附多個檔案，就重複寫幾次這個旗標。這功能在 GitHub.com 與 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上都能用。
body.en:
⟦You paste developed photos into a logbook page by page: where a page already says "photo goes here", the print covers that spot; elsewhere it goes on at the end.⟧ Reporting a bug with a screenshot used to mean opening the web page to upload it first. `gh` now has `--attach`, which uploads local images and videos and puts them into the body of an issue, a pull request, or a comment.

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

If the body already references that local path, `gh` swaps in the uploaded URL; otherwise the attachment is appended. Repeat the flag to attach several files in one invocation. Attachments work on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

items.original:
## Attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

The repeatable `--attach` flag uploads local images and videos and adds them to issue, pull request, or comment bodies. If a body already references the local path, `gh` replaces it with the uploaded URL; otherwise it appends the attachment:

```shell
# Attach files when creating or editing an issue
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh issue edit 123 --attach ./walkthrough.mp4

# Attach files when creating or editing a pull request
gh pr create --attach ./before.png
gh pr edit 456 --attach ./after.png

# Attach files to comments
gh issue comment 123 --attach ./repro.png
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

Repeat the flag to attach multiple files in a single invocation. Attachments are available on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

For more information see https://gh.io/gh-attach and https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/

title.zh-TW: `gh issue develop` 能另開工作目錄，手上的東西不用收
title.en: `gh issue develop` can check the branch out in a separate worktree

body.zh-TW:
手邊的改動改到一半，issue 那頭又要你開一條新分支——以前得先收拾現場才能切過去。現在 `gh issue develop` 可以幫 issue 建好連動的分支，並且把它簽出到一個新的 Git worktree（工作樹，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），你目前這份工作目錄原封不動。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要趕另一項工程時，不必把現場拆掉重排，而是在旁邊另闢一塊作業區，兩邊同時進行。⟧
body.en:
You are halfway through a change when an issue needs a fresh branch, and until now you had to tidy up before switching over. `gh issue develop` can now create the linked branch for an issue and check it out in a new Git worktree, a second working copy of the same project that stands on its own, leaving your current working copy untouched.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦When a site has to start a second job, the crew does not tear down what is already laid out; they open a separate work area beside it and run both at once.⟧

items.original:
## Worktree support extended to `gh issue develop` 

`gh issue develop` can now create a linked branch and check it out in a new Git worktree, leaving your current working copy unchanged:

```shell
# Create a linked branch for an issue and check it out in a worktree
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```
